Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

THE MAILMAN — EXPRESS DELIVERY.
Preserve the exact slim dark-skinned man, tan short-sleeved uniform and matching trousers, peaked delivery cap, dark sunglasses, shoulder patches, brown belt, black shoes and large white ankle wings. Do not change uniform into another outfit or add a bag absent from the reference. One plain small parcel is the delivery prop, no readable address.
0–1.2s: full body; he balances the small parcel on one hand, checks it with a quick glance, then crouches as his ankle wings spread and gold electricity coils around his shoes.
1.2–3.2s: he flicks the parcel toward the far cyan distance and LAUNCHES after it at absurd speed. Camera races alongside him, wings pumping and limbs posed clearly, multiple long tapered gold afterimages marking acceleration.
3.2–4.8s: camera pulls far wide to show him overtaking the parcel, carving a huge loop around it and arriving ahead of it. The loop forms an enormous winged-envelope lightning emblem. He catches the parcel on one palm with a thunderous gold-and-white impact star and a brief hold: faster than his own express delivery.
4.8–6s: snap push into a low-angle hero shot as exact title "EXPRESS DELIVERY" slams in two bold lines; he presents the intact parcel toward the viewer, confident smile.
6–8s: camera eases back enough to show the ankle wings settling while he taps the parcel twice and adjusts his cap. One last tiny spark zips around his shoe and stops. Sound: parcel flick, sprint ignition, huge accelerating whoosh, sonic snap, clean catch impact, title slam, settling wing feathers.

A SPARE GUS — PERSONAL SPACE IS SEASONAL.
Preserve the exact illustrated man: tousled black hair, curled dark mustache, light yellow rolled-sleeve collared shirt, blue trousers, brown low-top sneakers and enormous green asparagus stalk used as a staff. Exaggerated expressive comic performance.
0–1.2s: full-body stance; he measures the distance in front of himself with the asparagus, furrows his brow, then dramatically winds it back over his shoulder.
1.2–3.2s: he swings. The asparagus telescopes to an ABSURD length deep into the cyan distance, pushing away a floating red impact emblem with a gigantic gold-green starburst. Camera rapidly tracks along the length to reveal just how far his personal space now extends. One continuous asparagus stalk, finite shape, no landscape or background panel.
3.2–4.8s: he yanks the stalk back like a lever. A spectacular fan of enormous asparagus spears unfurls behind him, interlocks into a semicircular protective barrier, then slams upright in a thunderous staggered row. Yellow-green leaf shards, strong ink edges, a localized bright impact core; cyan gaps remain around the entire formation. He remains clearly visible in front.
4.8–6s: camera SNAP-PUSHES toward his stern face as exact title "PERSONAL SPACE IS SEASONAL" lands in three large readable comic lines, with the head kept clear.
6–8s: he plucks one tiny spare asparagus from the huge formation, offers it politely toward the viewer, and relaxes into a comically satisfied mustache curl. Camera eases out to preserve the oversized vegetable backdrop and clear hero silhouette. Sound: staff windup, accelerating extension whistle, huge springy impact, three dense plant-stone-like locking thumps, title slam, tiny final pluck.

AHKI — THE USUAL.
Preserve the exact illustrated friendly bearded man, black knit cap, white hoodie under dark green shop apron, pens and keys, striped towel, dark pants and gray-white chunky sneakers. His props are a large wrapped sandwich, long receipt and compact grocery crate.
0–0.7s: establish full body; he gives a welcoming nod, flicks the receipt dramatically and tosses the sandwich upward with effortless confidence.
0.7–2.4s: the receipt unfurls into an ENORMOUS looping ribbon, catching a swirling explosion of oversized bread, tomato, lettuce and deli-sandwich ingredients. Camera rockets backward to show the whole food-and-paper orbit, then races forward as everything SLAMS together into one monumental golden-lit sandwich, a giant comic impact star behind it. No shop interior or floor; finite receipt loops and ink-edged food shapes against pure cyan. No readable receipt text.
2.4–3.5s: snap-push to his proud grin as he catches the neatly wrapped final sandwich and presents it toward camera. Exact title "THE USUAL" slams above his shoulder with a huge outlined comic burst.
3.5–5s: the last extra-long receipt flutters down, he tears it with one crisp gesture and gives a knowing nod while offering the sandwich. Hold the title and charismatic pose. One continuous preparation-to-serving spectacle, not several attacks. Sound: paper whip, accelerating ingredient whooshes, colossal assembly impact, title slam, final crisp receipt tear. All action resolves within five seconds.

AIRHEADED MODEL — WRONG GATE, GREAT LIGHTING.
Preserve the exact illustrated adult woman, short dark wavy bob, silver hoop earrings, cobalt-blue sleeveless fitted dress, white ankle boots. Keep her blue outfit saturated cobalt, not turquoise; do not alter costume. Personality: distracted but effortlessly photogenic.
0–1.2s: full-body pose, she looks the wrong way with a puzzled expression while a small floating golden doorway outline appears beside her. This is a finite magical prop with pure cyan showing through its opening, no building or airport scenery.
1.2–3.2s: she casually steps through the doorway and a tremendous ivory-and-gold wind spiral sweeps her far into the depth of the cyan void. Camera whips after her, then pulls wide to reveal three enormous freestanding golden doorway outlines aligned in perspective; she sails past them with her dress and hair moving naturally, never changing outfit.
3.2–4.8s: she notices her reflection in a small suspended gold-rimmed mirror and instantly strikes a perfect model pose. That sudden stop unleashes a gigantic butterfly-shaped gust of ink-edged ivory wind ribbons and scattered golden sparkles, with localized camera-flash stars. One halo remains around the now-distant first doorway as a protective visual motif; no extra person.
4.8–6s: a dramatic SNAP-PUSH catches her confident face at the exact best angle as title "WRONG GATE, GREAT LIGHTING" slams into three bold readable comic lines. Flash accents are small foreground stars, never full-frame whiteout.
6–8s: she holds the pose, then realizes she is facing the wrong doorway, gives a tiny sheepish smile and confidently pivots toward the other one. Wind ribbons settle and the title remains legible. Sound: airy doorway chime, huge accelerating wind sweep, sudden gust impact, camera clicks without voices, title slam, playful final heel tap. No narration, dialogue or music.
